---
type: wordle
title: 'Tangent of an angle, $\tan\theta$'
lhs: "tan θ ="
answer: opp ÷ adj
keys: opp adj hyp ÷ ×
---

In a right triangle, write $\tan\theta$ using the sides **opp** (opposite $\theta$), **adj** (adjacent to $\theta$) and **hyp** (hypotenuse).

## Hint
Use the memory trick **SOH CAH TOA**. Each group of three letters is one function.

## Hint
In each group, the first letter is the function and the next two are the sides: the first side is divided by the second.

## Solution
**Answer:** $\tan\theta = \frac{\textcolor{#A60000}{\text{opposite}}}{\textcolor{#0000A6}{\text{adjacent}}}$ (**TOA**)

```{.tikz}
\begin{tikzpicture}[scale=1.1]
  \coordinate (B) at (0,0); \coordinate (A) at (4,0); \coordinate (C) at (4,2.6);
  \draw[seg, blue!65!black, line width=1.6pt] (B) -- (A);
  \draw[seg, red!65!black, line width=1.6pt] (A) -- (C);
  \draw[seg] (C) -- (B);
  \draw (3.7,0) -- (3.7,0.3) -- (4,0.3);
  \pic[draw, "$\theta$", angle eccentricity=1.6, angle radius=0.7cm] {angle = A--B--C};
  \node[below, blue!65!black, font=\small] at (2,0) {adjacent};
  \node[right, red!65!black, font=\small] at (4,1.3) {opposite};
  \node[above left, font=\small] at (2,1.3) {hypotenuse};
\end{tikzpicture}
```
